desc:
🧪 Brew potions for weird and wonderful guests, hatch rare pets, and turn your first cauldron into a massively successful hotel! It keeps earning even when you're offline!💤

HOW TO PLAY:
⚗️ BREW - Put ingredients into your cauldron!
🏨 EXPAND - Add floors to increase your hotel's guest capacity.
🐾 HATCH EGGS - Collect rare pets to dig for ingredients, speed up brewing, charm guests, and ride as mounts!
😈 PURGE - Raid rival hotels and steal their highest-value guests!
💤 AFK - Earn cash and auto-brew potions even while offline.
📖 INDEX - Discover and find every pet, NPC, ingredient, and decor item.

👍 Next exclusive code at 1,500 Likes!
🎁 Join the group for a FREE Rare Ingredient Pack!
